value.name: host-transport
value.premises: The host transport is a secret-terminating boundary, not persistence. Acquisition, sockets, startup, authentication and cancellation borrow secret-owned buffers; only bounded public placeholders and structurally admitted public frames cross into the upstream driver. Fixed diagnostics preserve their bytes; other whole messages stay secret-owned. This source review is bounded to the declared fixture and protocol profile; independent integration admission remains held. The owned session-end watch records only the first closed public cause and does no storage or transport work when observed.
